Sindhura L H Bangalore, India | sindhuralh13@gmail.com | +91-8310055408 LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/sindhura-l-h-242947217

Network Engineer | Network Automa2on | Cloud Networking (AWS)

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Detail-oriented Network Engineer with 4 years of hands-on experience across rouNng, switching, wireless, ﬁrewall, and automaNon in large-scale enterprise environments. Skilled at debugging complex network issues across OSI Layers, collaboraNng with engineering teams, and driving operaNonal excellence. As part of the Juniper-on-Juniper (JonJ) program, I manage and opNmize Juniper’s internal network infrastructure, ensuring high reliability and security across global sites rather than external customer environments. Experienced with Juniper, FireMon, and AWS networking, with pracNcal use of Python and Ansible for automaNng deployments and troubleshooNng. Passionate about building scalable, automated, and resilient network systems.

KEY SKILLS

Routing & Switching

Advanced knowledge of routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies: VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP, VRRP • • Understanding of SD-WAN fundamentals and architectures • Experience with path selection, and convergence troubleshooting

Cloud Networking (AWS)

Hands-on experience with AWS VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Internet/NAT Gateways • Knowledge of AWS Transit Gateway and hybrid connectivity models • Security constructs: Security Groups, Network ACLs • Familiarity with VPC peering, routing design, and traffic flow analysis

Networking Protocols & Technologies

Strong foundation in TCP/IP stack, Ethernet, ARP, DNS, DHCP • Deep understanding of packet forwarding, MTU, and fragmentation • Experience with IPsec VPN (site-to-site concepts, encryption basics) • Knowledge of IP tunneling (GRE, encapsulation, overlay networks)

Network Automation & Programming

Proficient in Python for network automation, scripting, and troubleshooting • Experience working with REST APIs for network/service integration • Familiar with data formats: JSON, XML • Basic exposure to automation workflows and infrastructure-as-code concepts

Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

Experience in network monitoring, telemetry, and alerting systems • Strong troubleshooting skills using logs, packet analysis, and debugging tools • Knowledge of incident management, root cause analysis (RCA) • Understanding of change management and production network operations

Collaboration & Problem Solving

Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams (network, cloud, security, application)

Strong analytical skills to debug complex, ambiguous network issues • Ability to design scalable and reliable network solutions • Clear and concise technical communication and documentation skills

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Juniper Networks — Network Engineer II Bangalore, India | Aug 2022 – Present

Provided full-stack network support for enterprise environments, owning customer Nckets end-to-end across rouNng, switching, and security domains. • Deployed and maintained VLAN tagging and segmentaNon in on-prem and Apstra- managed data center fabrics to improve traﬃc eﬃciency. • Conﬁgured and opNmized rouNng protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and ﬁrewall policies via Juniper Security Director Cloud. • Leveraged FireMon for proacNve ﬁrewall policy opNmizaNon, improving compliance and reducing rule redundancy. • Troubleshot complex network issues across layers 1–4, coordinaNng with sojware and hardware teams for resoluNon. • Used Ansible and Python for conﬁguraNon management and repeNNve task automaNon.

Assisted in CVE-based vulnerability remediaNon and implemented network security hardening measures.

Key Achievements: • Deliver Excellence – Obsess About Quality (Feb 2025) • Everyday Hero Award (Sep 2024) • Deliver Excellence – Act with Urgency (Feb 2024) – For zero-day vulnerability remediaNon

Juniper Networks — DevOps Intern / Graduate Trainee Bangalore, India | Feb 2022 – Jul 2022

Automated device conﬁguraNon using Ansible playbooks and contributed to UI improvements for operaNonal visibility. • Assisted in Junos device upgrades, version staging, and post-validaNon checks. • Maintained inventory and supported conﬁguraNon cleanup during infrastructure decommissions.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering – InformaNon Science & Technology NMAM InsNtute of Technology, Karkala Udupi, Karnataka (2018–2022)

CERTIFICATIONS

• • • • Zscaler Zero Trust CerNﬁed Associate (ZTCA)

JNCIS–ENT | Juniper Networks JNCIA–Junos | Juniper Networks JNCIA–Mist AI | Juniper Networks JNCIA–DevOps | Juniper Networks
